Explain briefly why condensation appears on the outside of a glass of iced water on a humid day. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Water vapor in the humid air cools when it touches the cold glass. Cooler air cannot hold as much moisture, so excess vapor condenses into liquid droplets on the outside.
